_: THE SOURCE INDEX. Every document the book draws on, with a URL that can be fetched without a token. Read this first; walk from it to everything else.
_why: The book is written in sessions that begin with nothing. No memory of the last one, no access to the repos, no continuity except what was written down. On 18 August a whole working night was spent with the author unable to read a single file — every fact arrived by hand, and the two occasions where reasoning ran ahead of a live reading both produced wrong answers. This file is the fix: one place that says where everything is.
_law: A SOURCE THAT CANNOT BE REACHED IS NOT A SOURCE. It is a thing somebody remembers.
_howToRead: raw.githubusercontent.com is fetchable. github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/... is NOT — it is a browse page and it is blocked.
Sizes are given because context is finite. Fetch deliberately: the Siege chronicle alone is 433 KB and will crowd out everything else.
Anything marked private:true needs a token. Do not put one in a chat. Ask the captain for the passage.
The registers are REGENERATED by the ship. Never quote a number from this file — fetch the register and read it at the hour of writing.

The Beach. The frame, and the last human scene in the book.
The reading surface. Five bands, empty glass, the unwritten page.

the registers — read at the hour of writ.what: The plate register. Keys, variants, scenes, gaps, accepted mismatches.
the registers — read at the hour of writ.authority: LIVE. Regenerated on every push to img/. Never quote from memory.

the registers — read at the hour of writ.what: The key register. Every key, what it reaches, and the four states — RESOLVED, LOADED, AMBIGUOUS, ORPHAN.
The specification. 21 requirements extracted from the Book of the Dead and the briefs.
The weighing. The ship measured against the spec, every six hours.
The roster. 1,011 souls. Column zero is Rank; the name is column one — READ IT BY HEADER, NEVER BY POSITION.
the registers — read at the hour of writ.note: LARGE, and a probe that fell back to column zero once searched a column of integers for 'cleopatra' and reported eight empty lists with complete confidence.

the registers — read at the hour of writ.what: The art pipeline's own record — generation seeds, source briefs, crop notes, colour audits. Owned by the Python tools; read here, never written.
the registers — read at the hour of writ.note: Holds observations that exist NOWHERE ELSE, e.g. that Caesar's plate shows segmentata armour a century late, accepted knowingly because it is unworn.

the registers — read at the hour of writ.what: The fleet reading — ships, crew, watches, drift, health.
Six Workers: crons, bindings, secret NAMES. No values.
The pane watch. Every pane, on disk and in the world.

the instruments.what: Walks the roster and the keys. Writes KEYS.json.
Measures the ship against the spec.
Walks every pane, on disk and live.
The watches. Knocks on the write door without opening it.

the surfaces.what: The arena, the book store, the codex, the terminal, the counsel. Everything the reader meets.
the surfaces.note: VERY LARGE. grep for a section; do not fetch whole.

the surfaces.what: THE registry of panes. One source of truth.

the briefs — 41 files, 8 of them linked.what: THE SIEGE OF AMENTI, 4-7 July 2026. Nine books of chronicle plus the field journal. Written the week it happened. 433 KB — fetch a section.
THE SPEECH DOCTRINE. The text-to-speech architecture. ONE OF THE TWO CAPABILITIES that make the site what it is — and it was linked from nowhere.
THE VOICE THAT CARRIES. Metering, chunking, the archive. Ch. I is the flood: an engine does not run on a tank of fuel dumped into the cylinder at once.
The reading room, the chat, and the voice path.
Amenti Studios. Image generation. THE SECOND OF THE TWO CAPABILITIES.
The Sacred Frames. Also linked from nowhere.
The Docket. The filing that is a locator and not a sentence.
Brief XII, THE SEPARATION OF POWER. Page1 cites it by name for the gateway scene.
Ascension. Fig. V is the pyramid the gateway is built on: people at the base, the proxy the lit capstone.
The Velvet Resolver. One name, one person, exact match or null.
THE PROBE CORPS. The doctrine, the roster, and the unit that accuses the system before it can lie to its captain.

branches._note: Fleet-Documents' default branch is literally named `branch`. It is not a placeholder. A URL built with `main` there returns 404, and that 404 looks exactly like a missing file.

_finding: THE HUB LINKS EIGHT BRIEFS. THE REPO HOLDS FORTY-ONE. The Engineering tab shows a subset and does not say so, and this index was built from that tab — so its first cut was missing thirty-three documents, including the SPEECH DOCTRINE and THE SACRED FRAMES, which are the two capabilities the captain names as the ones that make the site what it is. A list that shows part of a thing without saying which part is the same fault as a green lamp with nothing behind it.
